scene.label: Act 3, Scene 5
scene.title: SCENE V. A room in the Garter Inn
scene.location: A room in the Garter Inn

lines.text: Bardolph, I say!
lines.plainText: Bardolph I say

lines.text: Here, sir.
lines.plainText: Here sir

lines.text: Go fetch me a quart of sack; put a toast in 't.
lines.plainText: Go fetch me a quart of sack put a toast in 't

lines.text: Here's Mistress Quickly, sir, to speak with you.
lines.plainText: Here's Mistress Quickly sir to speak with you

lines.text: Come, let me pour in some sack to the Thames water, for my belly's as cold as if I had swallowed snowballs for pills to cool the reins. Call her in.
lines.plainText: Come let me pour in some sack to the Thames water for my belly's as cold as if I had swallowed snowballs for pills to cool the reins Call her in

lines.text: Come in, woman.
lines.plainText: Come in woman

lines.text: By your leave, I cry you mercy. Give your worship good morrow.

lines.text: Take away these chalices. Go, brew me a pottle of sack finely.
lines.plainText: Take away these chalices Go brew me a pottle of sack finely

lines.text: With eggs, sir?
lines.plainText: With eggs sir

lines.text: Simple of itself. I'll no pullet sperm in my brewage.
lines.plainText: Simple of itself I'll no pullet sperm in my brewage

lines.text: Marry, sir, I come to your worship from Mistress Ford.
lines.plainText: Marry sir I come to your worship from Mistress Ford

lines.text: Mistress Ford? I have had ford enough. I was thrown into the ford, I have my belly full of ford.
lines.plainText: Mistress Ford I have had ford enough I was thrown into the ford I have my belly full of ford

lines.text: Alas the day, good heart, that was not her fault. She does so take on with her men; they mistook their erection.

lines.text: So did I mine, to build upon a foolish woman's promise.
lines.plainText: So did I mine to build upon a foolish woman's promise

lines.text: Well, she laments, sir, for it, that it would yearn your heart to see it. Her husband goes this morning a-birding; she desires you once more to come to her, between eight and nine. I must carry her word quickly. She'll make you amends, I warrant you.

lines.text: Well, I will visit her. Tell her so, and bid her think what a man is. Let her consider his frailty, and then judge of my merit.
lines.plainText: Well I will visit her Tell her so and bid her think what a man is Let her consider his frailty and then judge of my merit

lines.text: I will tell her.
lines.plainText: I will tell her

lines.text: Do so. Between nine and ten, sayst thou?

lines.text: Eight and nine, sir.
lines.plainText: Eight and nine sir

lines.text: Well, be gone. I will not miss her.
lines.plainText: Well be gone I will not miss her

lines.text: Peace be with you, sir.
lines.plainText: Peace be with you sir

lines.text: I marvel I hear not of Master Brook; he sent me word to stay within. I like his money well. O, here he comes.
lines.plainText: I marvel I hear not of Master Brook he sent me word to stay within I like his money well O here he comes

lines.text: God bless you, sir.
lines.plainText: God bless you sir

lines.text: Now, Master Brook, you come to know what hath passed between me and Ford's wife?
lines.plainText: Now Master Brook you come to know what hath passed between me and Ford's wife

lines.text: That indeed, Sir John, is my business.
lines.plainText: That indeed Sir John is my business

lines.text: Master Brook, I will not lie to you. I was at her house the hour she appointed me.
lines.plainText: Master Brook I will not lie to you I was at her house the hour she appointed me

lines.text: And how sped you, sir?
lines.plainText: And how sped you sir

lines.text: Very ill-favouredly, Master Brook.
lines.plainText: Very illfavouredly Master Brook

lines.text: How so, sir? Did she change her determination?
lines.plainText: How so sir Did she change her determination

lines.text: No. Master Brook, but the peaking cornuto her husband, Master Brook, dwelling in a continual 'larum of jealousy, comes me in the instant of our encounter, after we had embraced, kissed, protested, and, as it were, spoke the prologue of our comedy; and at his heels a rabble of his companions, thither provoked and instigated by his distemper, and, forsooth, to search his house for his wife's love.

lines.text: What, while you were there?
lines.plainText: What while you were there

lines.text: While I was there.
lines.plainText: While I was there

lines.text: And did he search for you, and could not find you?
lines.plainText: And did he search for you and could not find you

lines.text: You shall hear. As good luck would have it, comes in one Mistress Page, gives intelligence of Ford's approach; and, in her invention and Ford's wife's distraction, they conveyed me into a buck-basket.
lines.plainText: You shall hear As good luck would have it comes in one Mistress Page gives intelligence of Ford's approach and in her invention and Ford's wife's distraction they conveyed me into a buckbasket

lines.text: A buck-basket!
lines.plainText: A buckbasket

lines.text: By the Lord, a buck-basket! Rammed me in with foul shirts and smocks, socks, foul stockings, greasy napkins, that, Master Brook, there was the rankest compound of villainous smell that ever offended nostril.
lines.plainText: By the Lord a buckbasket Rammed me in with foul shirts and smocks socks foul stockings greasy napkins that Master Brook there was the rankest compound of villainous smell that ever offended nostril

lines.text: And how long lay you there?
lines.plainText: And how long lay you there

lines.text: Nay, you shall hear, Master Brook, what I have suffered to bring this woman to evil for your good. Being thus crammed in the basket, a couple of Ford's knaves, his hinds, were called forth by their mistress to carry me in the name of foul clothes to Datchet Lane. They took me on their shoulders, met the jealous knave their master in the door, who asked them once or twice what they had in their basket. I quaked for fear lest the lunatic knave would have searched it; but Fate, ordaining he should be a cuckold, held his hand. Well, on went he for a search, and away went I for foul clothes. But mark the sequel, Master Brook. I suffered the pangs of three several deaths: first, an intolerable fright to be detected with a jealous rotten bell-wether; next, to be compassed like a good bilbo in the circumference of a peck, hilt to point, heel to head; and then, to be stopped in, like a strong distillation, with stinking clothes that fretted in their own grease. Think of that, a man of my kidney, think of that—that am as subject to heat as butter; a man of continual dissolution and thaw. It was a miracle to 'scape suffocation. And in the height of this bath, when I was more than half stewed in grease, like a Dutch dish, to be thrown into the Thames and cooled, glowing hot, in that surge, like a horseshoe! Think of that—hissing hot—think of that, Master Brook.

lines.text: In good sadness, sir, I am sorry that for my sake you have suffered all this. My suit, then, is desperate. You'll undertake her no more?
lines.plainText: In good sadness sir I am sorry that for my sake you have suffered all this My suit then is desperate You'll undertake her no more

lines.text: Master Brook, I will be thrown into Etna, as I have been into Thames, ere I will leave her thus. Her husband is this morning gone a-birding; I have received from her another embassy of meeting. 'Twixt eight and nine is the hour, Master Brook.

lines.text: 'Tis past eight already, sir.
lines.plainText: 'Tis past eight already sir

lines.text: Is it? I will then address me to my appointment. Come to me at your convenient leisure, and you shall know how I speed; and the conclusion shall be crowned with your enjoying her. Adieu. You shall have her, Master Brook. Master Brook, you shall cuckold Ford.
lines.plainText: Is it I will then address me to my appointment Come to me at your convenient leisure and you shall know how I speed and the conclusion shall be crowned with your enjoying her Adieu You shall have her Master Brook Master Brook you shall cuckold Ford

lines.text: Hum! Ha! Is this a vision? Is this a dream? Do I sleep? Master Ford, awake; awake, Master Ford! There's a hole made in your best coat, Master Ford. This 'tis to be married; this 'tis to have linen and buck-baskets! Well, I will proclaim myself what I am. I will now take the lecher. He is at my house. He cannot scape me. 'Tis impossible he should. He cannot creep into a half-penny purse, nor into a pepperbox. But, lest the devil that guides him should aid him, I will search impossible places. Though what I am I cannot avoid, yet to be what I would not shall not make me tame. If I have horns to make one mad, let the proverb go with me: I'll be horn-mad.
